categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Acrobiosystems Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the biotechnology sector, focusing on recombinant proteins, antibodies, and related biological reagents and technical services. Its products support global biopharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and research institutions in drug discovery, cell immunotherapy, diagnostic reagent development, and production processes. The company also provides custom services, development services, and detection services related to biological reagents.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced gene engineering and cell engineering technologies for recombinant protein production, including membrane protein expression and purification, inducible mammalian cell expression, gene site-specific integration, and chemical definition of cell culture media. It has developed multiple core technology platforms such as protein modification and labeling, high-throughput molecular interaction analysis, and GMP-grade production systems. The company also integrates AI-driven protein engineering and high-throughput screening to enhance product quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Its key customers include top global pharmaceutical companies like Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer, Novartis, Gilead, Roche, Merck, and leading domestic biopharmaceutical firms such as Hengrui Medicine, Innovent Biologics, Junshi Biosciences, WuXi Biologics, BeiGene, and Legend Biotech. The company serves industries involved in biopharmaceutical R&D, cell immunotherapy, diagnostic reagent development, and clinical research, covering applications in oncology, autoimmune diseases, cardiovascular diseases, infectious diseases, and neurological disorders.
categories.geographic_coverage: Acrobiosystems operates globally with subsidiaries and sales networks in China, the United States, Europe, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore. Its products and services cover nearly 80 countries and regions worldwide, with significant revenue generated from both domestic (approximately 33.5%) and international markets (approximately 66.5%). The company maintains R&D centers in China and the U.S. and plans to expand production bases overseas to strengthen global supply capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream segment of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, providing critical biological reagents such as recombinant proteins and antibodies used in drug discovery, development, and production. It also offers midstream technical services including custom protein and antibody development, analytical testing, and quality control solutions, supporting downstream pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes deepening global presence, expanding R&D capabilities, and enhancing production scale and quality systems. It invests heavily in AI-enabled protein engineering platforms, cell and gene therapy-related products, organoid technology, and membrane protein expression. The company aims to broaden its product portfolio to cover cell therapy, companion diagnostics, clinical sample analysis, and clinical drug monitoring, while fostering platform business models and strengthening talent acquisition and international collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of recombinant proteins, antibodies, reagents, and related technical services including custom development, analytical testing, and product licensing. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distribution partnerships globally, with a majority of sales conducted via direct channels. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Acrobiosystems is positioned as a leading supplier in the recombinant protein and biological reagent market, competing with both domestic and international biotechnology companies. It holds a strong competitive advantage due to its broad product portfolio, high-quality GMP-grade products, advanced technology platforms, and extensive global customer base. The company is recognized as a key partner for top-tier biopharmaceutical firms and is a major player in the upstream bioreagent supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 645 million, representing an 18.65% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 124 million, with a slight decline compared to the previous year. The company has steadily expanded its asset base, with total assets reaching nearly RMB 2.9 billion. It maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures exceeding RMB 165 million, reflecting a robust growth trajectory and commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Acrobiosystems differentiates itself through high-quality, GMP-grade recombinant proteins and antibodies tailored to meet stringent biopharmaceutical development and production standards. Its products are supported by extensive application data and multi-dimensional quality verification, reducing client experimental costs and risks. The company leverages cutting-edge technologies including AI-driven protein engineering and offers comprehensive technical services, positioning itself as a trusted platform partner that accelerates drug development and clinical application for global biopharma customers.
